before_conditions: The TrailsIntentEntrypoint contract is intended to work with Sequence v3 wallets, which are smart contract wallets.
The contract uses ECDSA.recover() for signature validation.
A user is a smart contract wallet (like Sequence).
The signature is produced by the wallet owner (an EOA).
required_property: The contract should validate signatures from smart contract wallets using EIP-1271 (isValidSignature), so that off-chain signed intents from the intended user base (Sequence v3 smart contract wallets) are accepted on-chain.
bad_outcome: ECDSA.recover() returns the owner's EOA address instead of the smart contract wallet address, so recovered != user and the transaction reverts; smart wallet users cannot deposit via intents, all off-chain signed intents fail on-chain, the core value proposition fails silently, and users may lose gas and believe the system is broken.
